lines: — DAY 113 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Pawpaw went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
👀 Mia was talking about home — then stopped mid-sentence, recalibrated, and said "Denver" just a fraction too deliberately. Whatever home is, it isn't where that sentence started.
🎁 You find a small bundle tucked where you'll find it. No one saw it left there.
"They're sending Vex after you tomorrow. He's bored. Be somewhere else."
(355 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)
Someone's bread rose twice as high this morning. The old ones say that's Hunter's doing. Nobody argues.
Dawn. You wake rested. (+0 health, energy restored. By the fire. Good enough.)
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
📋 Génesis — 💧 Fetch water. Génesis nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (20/6/4), 10 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT.
Olivia left 1 branch by the stash. No announcement. That's how it works here.
💧 Ruby returns with 16L, but the cistern only holds 15L more.
🎣 Ruby worked the creek — 2 fish, +360 kcal to the pantry.
🌱 Ruby looks over the garden: turned soil, nothing planted. Someone has to sow first.
🍲 Ruby cooked for the haven — meals stretched. Ruby worked the smoke racks too — 6 batches preserved (~2416 kcal, keeps a couple of weeks).
💧 Génesis returns with 13L, but the cistern only holds 0L more.
🪤 Génesis is back from the snares: +327 kcal to the pantry.
🪤 Ruby is back. "Snares were empty. They'll keep."
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
💧 Ruby returns with 12L, but the cistern only holds 0L more.
🎣 Ruby worked the creek — 4 fish, +840 kcal to the pantry.
🌱 Ruby looks over the garden: turned soil, nothing planted. Someone has to sow first.
🍲 Ruby cooked for the haven — meals stretched.
You catch fragments by the fire — Mia telling Ruby about you. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
Génesis sets out to find Mia. "Won't be long."
🚶 Olivia is back — found Génesis.
Tashi heads out to check the snares. "Wire doesn't lie."
Sigrun sets out to find Génesis. "Won't be long."
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
Your pack is full — water is heavy (1L = 1kg). Drink some or drop weight before filling.
Ruby left 3 branches by the stash. No announcement. That's how it works here.
💧 Ruby returns with 17L, but the cistern only holds 0L more.
🎣 Ruby worked the creek — 5 fish, +1020 kcal to the pantry.
🌱 Ruby looks over the garden: turned soil, nothing planted. Someone has to sow first.
🍲 Ruby cooked for the haven — meals stretched.
You catch fragments by the fire — Génesis telling Olivia about you. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
🚶 Mia is back — found Génesis.
Elijah sits by the door re-lacing a strap, testing each pull before the next.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
Night settles. The fire is the whole world now. No watches posted. The dark feels bigger than it should.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
◈ ABILITY — Spotlight: The room is already warm. Audience starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — Callback: One bad act can be redone. (Offered once, after a bad beat.)
◈ ABILITY — Plant: A cheering section, planted. +2 now — pray they never check the seating chart.
◈ ABILITY — Edit Bay: Final cut on your own legend. (Offered in the final beat.)
🔴 LIVE! the variety finale: ONE NIGHT ONLY

◈ THE BELOVED — The audience is chanting. You don't know the words — it isn't a language with words — but you know the feeling. The table can't move against the cast's favorite. That's leverage. Tonight, the cast is your village.
The table has read your ledger. The food truth was shared. The dark road is open.
Hunter tells the hunt — the real one, with the fear left in. The audience goes silent in the good way. Silence, at this scale, is deafening.
The feast song — the one about eating like it matters, because it does. Trillions of beings who never ate anything hear it and feel hungry for the first time. The ratings spike is audible.

You take the cut. The bad moments vanish — the deaths, the hunger, all of it, gone from the record. The audience loves you perfectly. The village watches the perfect version of you and doesn't recognize anyone.
◈ THE BELOVED — the last choice is yours, and it's live.
◈ THE BELOVED — "Let the audience speak."

The audience speaks — on cue, on brand, on message. The show becomes the government, and the government is *you*, focus-grouped. It works. It will always work. Nobody will ever know if the love was real, least of all you. The ratings are perfect forever.
◈ Desmond Clarke walks out of the light alone, which is how he walked in. The village endures. That was always the story.

💛 You hold Bus Schedule. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, worn smooth by use, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)
📋 Génesis — 🎣 Fish. Génesis nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
📋 Ruby — 🎣 Fish. Ruby nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
📋 Olivia — 🍲 Cook. Olivia nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
"Why are YOU giving orders?" Ruby doesn't raise their voice. That's worse.
